name: Determine Attendance Rule score vector from code
ev: Code line EduTrace_Revised_Pipeline.py:965 passes `1.0 - att_vals` to roc_auc_score / average_precision_score and `(att_vals < att_thr_scaled)` as the binary vector. Re-run reproduces every published cell exactly: AUC-ROC 0.8678, AUC-PR 0.1284, precision 0.0893, recall 0.7143, F2 0.2976, macro-F1 0.5182. Methods M11 now documents the scoring for each row.

name: Engineer year-on-year lag features
ev: PARTIALLY SATISFIABLE — engineered and tested, but NOT learnable under the declared split. All four features have zero variance in the 2024-only training pool (nunique = 1, SD = 0) and variance only at test (att_delta SD 0.1692). Sensitivity arm at a 2026 cut, where they ARE learnable: AUC-PR 0.0350 → 0.0615, AUC-ROC 0.6090 → 0.7572, one always-missed case recovered — but on only 3 test positives. In M7, R7, R8.

ev: R8 states the boundary explicitly: individual-level probability estimates are not stable to register-error-scale noise, so the defensible output is a ranked shortlist for teacher review, not a stable individual probability and not an individual motivational diagnosis delivered by name.

name: Error analysis on consistently-missed cases across five seeds
ev: Run across all five seeds. Missed by all five: S17_2025, S57_2026, S122_2026 (scaled attendance 0.773, 0.639, 0.817). Recovered by all five: S06_2025, S88_2025 (scaled attendance 0.547, 0.516). CONFIRMS the supervisor's predicted profile: the consistently-missed students look unremarkable in the static snapshot. Reported in R7.

name: Re-run perturbation after lag features
ev: Perturbation re-run on both arms. Declared split: mean |Δp| 0.1265, max 0.8758, up to 3 of 7 dropout cases flipping in a single trial. 2026-cut sensitivity arm: mean |Δp| 0.0928 → 0.0803 with lag features — the predicted fall, though small. Reported in R8; Figure S4 regenerated.

name: Attendance Rule diagnosis (checklist doc, Finding A)
ev: CONFIRMED to 4 dp. Rule flags 56 records, FP 51, FPR 0.2116, single-point AUC-ROC 0.7513 — the supervisor computed 0.7514. F2 recomputed at 0.2976 matches the published cell.

name: Isotonic AUC-ROC arithmetic (checklist doc, Finding B)
ev: SUPERVISOR IS INCORRECT ON THIS ONE, and R10 now explains why. Our run reproduces a RISE (0.5969 → 0.6165). Isotonic is monotone NON-DECREASING, so it cannot reorder but it can create ties; a tied pair scores 0.5, so tying a discordant pair RAISES AUC-ROC. A rise is admissible, not an arithmetic impossibility. AUC-PR fell as expected (-0.0100).

name: Seed-42 disclosure (checklist doc, Finding C)
ev: M14 now discloses that every single-run result rests on seed 42 and commits to printing the seed-42 value alongside the five-seed mean wherever a single-run figure enters a comparison (Table 3 footnote ¶).

name: Synthetic supplement was not CTGAN and not reproducible
ev: NOT ON THE CHECKLIST — found by auditing the code. The supplied synthetic_student_data_v3.csv is a bit-for-bit match to the pipeline's logistic-DGP FALLBACK at seed 42, not CTGAN; final_summary_v3.json confirms 'Logistic DGP (fallback)'. CTGANSynthesizer was also constructed with no seed, so the supplement differed on every run. Fixed: gen_synth.py seeds before construction/fit/sample, verified reproducible (two runs, DataFrame.equals = True), and the supplement is committed as an artefact. M4/Table 1/M21 corrected.

name: Pool composition was misreported
ev: NOT ON THE CHECKLIST. M8/M9/R1 claimed 447 non-dropout : 83 dropout (15.7%, 5.39:1). The actual pool under the locked run is 468:62 (11.7%, 7.55:1), and scale_pos_weight is 7.49, not 5.39. Corrected in M8, M9, M12/Table 2, R1 and Table 1b. This is also why the supervisor's SMOTE no-op finding does not hold.

name: SHAPtoSMS had no implementation
ev: NOT ON THE CHECKLIST. Algorithm 1 was unimplemented in both the .py and the notebook (SMS_CHAR_LIMIT defined at line 131, never referenced; no packer, lexicon or character counting anywhere). Table 5's published figures had no code behind them. Implemented to the M12 spec (shaptosms.py) and Table 5 regenerated from a real run: 57/57 within 160 characters, lengths 70–155 (mean 96), 1–6 factors (mean 2.46).

name: grade_level perfectly confounded with academic_year
ev: NOT ON THE CHECKLIST. The panel is a single cohort: 2024 = 100% Grade 7, 2025 = 100% Grade 8, 2026 = 100% Grade 9. So grade_level has ZERO training variance and is wholly out-of-distribution at test, and the temporal hold-out is simultaneously a grade hold-out. This is a substantive and defensible explanation for near-chance AUC-ROC that the manuscript previously lacked. Added to M9 and Table 1b.

name: RPS measured something other than what M17 described
ev: NOT ON THE CHECKLIST (the supervisor inferred a different mechanism). The original `rps_at_k` checked whether the top-|SHAP| feature's SIGN agreed with the true label — a directional-agreement statistic that never compares two orderings, so it could not be 1.0 'by construction'. Both quantities are now implemented and reported under separate names (RPS and DAS) in M17 and R5.
